name: hermes_cli_gateway_platform_status
notes: Traced copy of gateway_wrappers.c::cgw_u_platform_status vs LIVE hermes_cli/gateway.py::_platform_status. Inputs encode <registry>\t<state>\t<result>; the twin builds synthetic platform dicts (registry entry with is_connected/check_fn, or token_var env) so the flags are derived from LIVE behavior. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, avoided): the C wrapper only models the binary configured/not-configured outcomes — LIVE's whatsapp/signal/email/matrix/weixin token_var branches can also return 'configured + paired' / 'partially configured' / 'enabled, not paired'; inputs avoid those platform keys.
